#Nonpareil curves
```{r, dev = "jpg"}
samples <- read.table('~/Data/Nonpareil_CText202122_Metadata.txt', header=TRUE, as.is=TRUE);
attach(samples);
nps <- Nonpareil.set(File, col=Col, labels=Name, plot.opts=list(xlim = c(1e+6,1e+18), ylim = c(0, 1.2), xlab = "Sequencing effort (bp)", ylab = "Estimated average coverage", plot.diversity = FALSE, plot.observed=FALSE, legend.opts = list(cex = 0.6, x = 'bottomright', bty = "n", ncol = 2, title = "Year, Inoculation")));
detach(samples);
summary <- summary(nps)
```
